meaning:
§ Kenath = "possession"
a city in Gilead east of the Jordan taken possession of by a certain Nobah and renamed in his own honour

elsewhere.note: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
